data.description:
Replace the legacy 4-key compound detection in mode-detect.sh with a one-line dso.workflow lookup.

## Testing Mode: GREEN (makes Task eb48-8d27-a5f2-4527 RED tests pass)

## File to Modify
plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh

## Implementation
Replace the 22-line script body with a thin delegator:
- Script resolves SCRIPT_DIR and calls: bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/read-config.sh" dso.workflow
- Preserve DSO_CONFIG_PATH test override: export it as WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE before calling read-config.sh (read-config.sh already honors WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE for config path resolution)
- Remove all legacy logic: grep for enforcement.strategy, merge.strategy, git remote check, and conditional logic
- Update the header comment to reflect new behavior
- Exit code propagation: script must exit with the same code read-config.sh returns

## Result
mode-detect.sh is reduced to ~8 lines: shebang + set line + SCRIPT_DIR resolution + optional DSO_CONFIG_PATH→WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE export + exec/call to read-config.sh dso.workflow

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 5 tests from Task eb48-8d27-a5f2-4527 pass (GREEN)
- Existing tests in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-config-driven.sh still pass if they call mode-detect.sh indirectly (verify by running that test suite)
- No references to enforcement.strategy or merge.strategy remain in mode-detect.sh
data.title: GREEN: plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh — one-line dso.workflow lookup
